items.title: Regions Financial Announces Upcoming Retirement of Dave Keenan and New Executive Leadership Appointments
items.summary: As Kate Danella of Regions succeeds Chief Administrative Officer Dave Keenan, John Jordan will be elevated to serve as head of Consumer Banking, and Chief People Officer Angela Santone will join the CEO’s leadership team. Regions Financial Corp. on Tuesday announced Chief Administrative Officer Dave Keenan will retire at the end of 2026 following more than two decades of leadership at the company. Kate Danella , currently head of Consumer Banking, will succeed Keenan as Chief Administrative Officer. John Jordan will succeed Danella as head of Consumer Banking, while Chief People Officer Angela Santone will begin reporting directly to Regions Chairman, President, and CEO John Turner .
